{{Quote|The Blackguard operates from the molten world of Mustafar. They are largely recluses and have sought dark side lore since they emerged from the ruins of Sith philosophy after the Battle of Ruusan nearly a thousand years ago.|[[Mother (title)/Legends|Mother]] [[Talzin/Legends|Talzin]], ''[[Wild Power]]''|<ref name="BoS">''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]''</ref>}}
The '''Blackguard''' was a [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] cult formed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]] after the [[New Sith Wars]]. Its members sought to increase their knowledge of power by studying other [[The Force/Legends|Force]] traditions.

==Organization and philosophy==
{{Quote|The Blackguard clings to the principle that acquiring knowledge is superior to exerting physical power.|Mother Talzin, ''Wild Power''|<ref name="BoS" />}}
The Blackguard was a [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] cult based on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]].<ref name="JATM" /> Its adepts lived largely as recluses<ref name="BoS" /> in the [[Smoking Forest/Legends|Smoking Forest]]'s [[Southern Jedi Ruins]].<ref name="SWG:AAP" />
[[File:Blackguard_wilder.jpg|thumb|left|230px|A Blackguard wilder.]]

The Blackguard emerged from the ashes of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] philosophy of the [[Brotherhood of Darkness/Legends|Brotherhood of Darkness]] destroyed at the [[Seventh Battle of Ruusan|Battle of Ruusan]].<ref name="BoS" /> The Blackguard believed to increase one's knowledge of the Force, one must understand the philosophies and abilities of other [[The Force/Legends|Force]] traditions around the galaxy.<ref name="JATM" /> Members of the cult believed that acquiring knowledge was superior to exerting physical power.<ref name="BoS" /> Nevertheless, Blackguard adepts were absolutely not pacifist.<ref name="SWG:AAP" />

Most of the members of the cult were skilled warriors wearing black [[Armor/Legends|armors]].<ref name="SWG:AAP" /> The Blackguard was better organized than other dark side cults.<ref name="JATM" /> There were four ranks among the adepts: minion, elite minion, wilder, and elite wilder.<ref name="SWGTCG:BW" /> The wilders were force users trained in [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|lightsaber combat]] and Force combat techniques while minions were non-Force-sensitive cultists armed with [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]].<ref name="SWG:AAP" /> Some wilders were known as Trinity Assassins.<ref name="SWG:Acb" /> Elite minions and wilders usually acted as squad leaders for regular minions. These minions acted as soldiers and were the most visible members of the cult, leading many to believe that the Blackguard was simply a paramilitary organization.<ref name="JATM" />

==History==
{{Quote|The primary temple is located on their side, and they won't let me anywhere near it. Their leader, San'sii, is there most of the time studying it. I told him that I could help him, but he just laughed and then I couldn't breath. He really freaks me out.|[[Mi Fon Lu]]|<ref name="SWG:AAP" />}}
[[File:Trials_of_the_Blackguard_SWG_TotC.jpg|thumb|right|230px|The [[Dark Jedi/Legends|dark Jedi]] [[Namman Cha]] endures the trials of the Blackguard to infiltrate their group.]]
The Blackguard was formed after the [[New Sith Wars]]<ref name="BoS" /> by the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Vulta Daanat]], a former member of the [[Brotherhood of Darkness/Legends|Brotherhood of Darkness]] and [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] of [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Skere Kaan]]. They set up a base in the Southern Jedi Ruins, on the planet Mustafar. Over the centuries, the cult varied drastically in size, at times growing to considerable proportions, and shrinking at other times to a handful of adepts.<ref name="JATM" />

The existence of the Blackguard was known of [[Mother (title)/Legends|Mother]] [[Talzin/Legends|Talzin]] of the [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] as well as by [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Era]]. Palpatine infiltrated his own agents among the Blackguard in order to acquire any knowledge the cult could uncover.<ref name="BoS" /> One such agent was the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Namman Cha]].<ref name="SWGTCG:TotB">{{SWGTCG|set=Threat of the Conqueror|cardname=Trials of the Blackguard}}</ref>

[[File:SansiiCombat-TrialsOfObiWan.jpg|thumb|left|250px|San'sii and his adepts engaging in a battle against a group of spacers.]]
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the cult was led by [[San'sii]] the Kursk.<ref name="SWG:AAP" /> San'sii was the first to recruit non-Force-sensitive people into the Blackguard ranks, thereby preventing the cult to disappear.<ref name="JATM" /> Around the time of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], a group of [[Treasure Hunters|treasure hunters]] led by [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Narl]] arrived on Mustafar and contested the control of the Southern Jedi Ruins by the Blackguard. Although the Blackguard cultists were Force users, the treasure hunters outnumbered the dark side adepts who were forced to accept a truce to share the ruins between the two groups.<ref name="SWG:AAP" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> [[Archaeology/Legends|archaeologist]] [[Mi Fon Lu]] of the [[Royal Academy/Legends|Theed Royal Academy]] sought to study the Southern Jedi Ruins but the Blackguard denied him access to the ruins. The archaeologist eventually tasked a group of adventurers to defeat the Blackguard. The group managed to kill many of the Blackguard adepts in the ruins, including their leaders San'sii and [[Vansk]], allowing Mi Fon Lu access.<ref name="SWG:AAP" /> Around the same time, a spacer was sent to the Southern Jedi Ruins by [[Pann]]'s droid [[Q4P3]] to recover an artifact known as the [[Codex]]. The spacer fought a Trinity Assassin in the ruins and delivered the artifact, which turned out to in fact be a [[Mustafar Sith holocron|Sith holocron]], to Q4P3.<ref name="SWG:Acb" />

Later, the Blackguard finally allied with the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. During their [[Mission to Mustafar (Renegade Squadron)|mission]] to destroy the [[Conqueror (superlaser)|''Conqueror'']] [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] in the [[Mustafar system/Legends|Mustafar system]], [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Alliance Special Forces]] of [[Renegade Squadron/Legends|Renegade Squadron]] fought a group of Blackguard elite minions led by [[Director of Imperial Intelligence]] [[Ysanne Isard]].<ref name="TotC" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Blackguard appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:AAP" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Blackguard was added to the game with the release of the expansion pack [[Star Wars Galaxies: Trials of Obi-Wan|''Trials of Obi-Wan'']] on [[November 1]], [[2005]].<ref name="SWG:AAP" />
